dct_description_sm:
Delineates the Growth Plan Policy Areas as part of the Places to Grow Act, 2005.

Growth Plan Policy Areas identify locations where specific policies of the Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe apply. These areas help guide how growth, intensification, employment, infrastructure, and environmental protection are managed to support complete communities and sustainable urban development.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
